_doc: Phase 91.Z contrast set. Authored BEFORE any correction, from the criteria in ROADMAP 91.Z3. Every NEGATIVE is paired with a POSITIVE in the SAME construction: a negative demonstrates protection only if its positive is actually recognised, otherwise the pair is VACUOUS and proves nothing. Pairs vary word order (value-first vs attribute-first), length, clause nesting and language, and cover an OPEN slot as well as closed ones. Includes the cases from reports/codex_review_91y/REVIEW.md and the three legitimate assertions whose coverage Y lost. Run: .venv/Scripts/python.exe scripts/run_write_set.py --set scripts/oracles/scope_contrast_v1.json   (no --mapper: this isolates the regex production path). 'expect': {} means write NOTHING and leave the prior value intact.
